text: Moglums are a family of aquatic enemies in and . They resemble angler fish. They can be found throughout the Erythia Sea. They can appear in either navy blue or dark green color schemes. They can appear submerged in water before attacking the party.
Morrack Inlet (Japanese: , Morakuto no Irie) is a Landmark in . It is located at the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region.
Mulus Depot (Japanese: , Murusu Hatchakuba) is a Landmark in . It is located at the Agnus Castle Barbican in the Cadensia Region.
Myoots are a family of enemies in . They are bat-like creatures found in Origin that resemble Vangs.

Munchygrub Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They are fossils of Munchygrubs from the Kingdom of Torna.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Mudclams are Shell Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Pentelas Region in . They can also be produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found on The Ragmos Desolation in . Four are needed for The Ragmos Desolation Collectopaedia.
Monstrum Mangos are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. It can also be purchased from Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan, or produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Morsula Skeeters are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 48-57 on Melnath's Shoulder, Everblight Plain or Captocorn Peak.
My Memories (Japanese: , Ore no Kioku) is an Ascension Quest in , dedicated to Triton.

Musical Tirkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 20-22 in Perrato Cave on Rae-Bel Tableland, and at level 33-42 at High Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region.

Muscat Noirs are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony 11 Caravan, or produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Monochromagnetites are Ore Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Cadensia Region in . They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found on The Ragmos Desolation in .
Mosaic Petals are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Mottlemarble Aries Meats are items in . They are dropped by Aries. One is needed during the quest Happiness.
Monicurry Specials are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. 2 Silver Nopon Coins can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients.
Musketeer Ignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 35 on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Morsula Fliers are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Flier family, and can be found at level 52-55 in Farlaine Underpass in Erythia Sea.
Mukiri Ottils are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ottil family, and can be found at level 44-45 at Anu Shoals in Erythia Sea.
Musketeer Gulkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gulkin family, and can be found at level 43-97 in Erythia Sea.
Muskul Gogols are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 56-57 at Cape Arcaphor in the Erythia Sea.
Muroon Bridge (Japanese: , Moran no Hashi) is a Location in . It is located at the Great Cotte Falls.
Monastic Necklaces are Accessories in . It can be obtained from Otherworldly Rodsin.
Mysterious Keycard is a Key Item in . It is obtained during the Standard Quest Shared Secret.
Momama is a Nopon NPC in . Momama can be found at Tsang Camp on Captocorn Peak.
Mudtalon Ansels are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 45-46 at Elsayer Cape on Rae-Bel Tableland.
Morbile Moramoras are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Moramora family, and can be found at level 79-80 in Millick Meadows.

Murder Knuckle is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Ghostfist Róisín while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

More Challenge Battles! is a DLC Quest in . It is part of New Hero & More Tough Challenges of the Expansion Pass. Upon completion of this quest, the Archsage's Gauntlet becomes available in the Land of Challenge.
Monado Rage is one of Shulk's arts in , and as a Hero in . The color of the Monado REX+'s blade turns red upon activation. __TOC__
The Mystery Unit Soldiers are two Bosses in . They are Liberator Soldiers that are fought alongside the Mystery Unit Captain at level 16 on the Aurora Shelf.
Mysterious Fragments are six Key Items in . They can be found throughout the Cent-Omnia Region. They are used to upgrade the party's Blades to level X.
Mona Ellooks are Normal Enemies in . They are members of the Ellook family, and can be found at level 13 on the Aurora Shelf.
The Mystery Unit Captain () is a Boss fought alongside two Mystery Unit Soldiers by Glimmer at level 16 on the Aurora Shelf. She is later revealed to be Panacea. This battle is a forced loss.

Mysterious Land is a track from and , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twelve of disc four from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack. The song plays in most Secret Areas. This track also plays in the Land of Challenge.

Mor Ardain - Roaming the Wastes - is a Field Track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track ten of disc three from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track ten of disc eight from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the day on the Upper and Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. This track also appears as a DLC music track in , included alongside Pyra and Mythra's Fighter Pack. It is a track option on Gaur Plain, the Cloud Sea of Alrest, Final Destination, and the three variants of Battlefield. Parts of this song are also remixed for the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Medley.

Monster Surprised You is a track from and , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track two of disc two on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track two of disc seven on the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during various Boss battles, and battles against Story Exclusive and Quest Exclusive Enemies.

The Mystery Drink is a Key Item in . It is a drink created by Bana by mixing a Glutton's Herb into the formula of his product, which he calls "BanaXxX". It is supposedly toxic to Homs and High Entia, causing them to become hopelessly addicted to the drink. Pororo gives the party a sample of the drink during The Future Within Our Grasp in order to help them stop Bana's scheme.
Mute Shrads are enemies in . They are Shrad machines, and can be found in Volitaris.
Multilock AA Zig (Japanese: , Tamokuteki Taikōkū-gata Jigu) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Zig family. It can be found at level 57 at Arctoras's Axle in Volitaris.

Mu-igo, the Deep-Ender (Japanese: , Gyokusai no Mu-igo) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Oc-serv family. It can be found at level 58 in Volitaris inside a cave along the side of the Lebra Fault Zone.
Molten Refridgium is an Important Item in . It can be found southwest of Lake Ciel in Sylvalum. It must be collected during New Skell on the Block.
The Mount M'gando Stone is an Important Item in . It is collected inside the Bestial Utopia in Cauldros during the course of Mount M'gando Mineralogy.
Myrah is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found at Garagorm's Arch in the Gormott Province during Go for it, Electra!, during which she must be talked to.

mpi is a Japanese vocalist and translator. He lived in New York for five years before returning to Japan to work as a translator. He provided the English lyrics for a number of songs composed by Hiroyuki Sawano. He is the singer of several songs from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack.
Mumutsu is an NPC in . She is a Nopon and can be found in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum. She is met during the mission The Ties That Bind. She is Tatsu's young sister.
The Nopon (Japanese: ; English dub: or ) are a recurring race of small fuzzy creatures found in every game in the .

Nero Andos (Japanese: , Nēro Andosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Andos family, and can be found at level 34 in the High Entia Tomb. Statistically, they are the weakest monsters in the tomb, but they make up for this by attacking in groups. A variant Nero Andos appears only during a story event battle in the Hall of Spirits on level GF.

Nikita (Japanese: , Nikīta) is a Homs in . He can be found in the tall grass near the Heart-to-Heart at the Refugee Camp on the Bionis' Leg. At Colony 6, he can be found east of Reconstruction HQ, in the middle of the shopping street, after he is saved from a Lazy Hox outside the Ether Mine.

Night Lilies (Japanese: , Naito Rirīmu) are collectables in . They can be found in the Eryth Sea. According to their description, they bloom at night and scatter by morning, creating a carpet of black over time. Four are required for Désirée's Apology.

Narine (Japanese: , Nerine) is a Homs in . She lives in Colony 9, and can be found in the Residential District, southwest of Tranquil Square. She is Françoise's daughter. She really likes Shulk, and gets in an argument about it with Paola, who prefers Reyn.

Night Wisps (Japanese: , Naito Ranpusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Wisp family, and can be found on Kneecap Hill in Tephra Cave at level 10 and levels 12-15 at night. They can drop the Glowing Wisp Fluid needed for Emergency Treatment.

Nic (Japanese: , Nūku) is a Homs in . He can be found in the northern portion of the Military District of Colony 9, behind the larger boxes and the wall of the platform. In Colony 6, he can be found in the very southeast corner of the Colony (upon reaching commerce Level 5, this area will be seen south of the bottommost shop).

Neonik (Japanese: , Naonami) is a Machina in . She is a candidate to move to Colony 6. She can be found under the platform just south of the Ether Light at the Fallen Arm, and east of Reconstruction HQ near the shops south of the watchtower at Colony 6. At one point she describes herself as elderly, being the oldest Machina and one of the oldest characters in the game at 9,892 years old. As a side note, Miqol is rumored to be 6,000 years old, and the Nopon Sage is 9,999 years old. It is unknown how old Zanza, his disciples or counterpart could be, however.
Natalia (Japanese: , Natārya) is a Homs in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found on the middle of the stairs leading to the Junks in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm.

Naroth (Japanese: , Natori) is a High Entia in . He can be found on the first floor of Alcamoth, north of the Imperial Palace. After the events of Mechonis Core, Talia reveals that he was killed in the chaos of Zanza's abrupt transformation of the pure-blooded High Entia into Telethia along with Ruthan.

Nelo (Japanese: , Nero) is a Nopon NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles. He has a fondness for drink and Highmore Caviar. He is a member of Alcamoth's Secret Club, and owns several Secret Club Cards, needed to be allowed entry. Nelo can be found near the base of the southern escalator, southeast of the Fountain of Hope in Alcamoth. After the events at the Mechonis Core, he can be found in Frontier Village, just before the Nopon Tower on the entry bridge from 19:00 till 3:00.

Nopo'rikh is a Nopon in . He can be found anytime at the Armu farm in Colony 6. He appears once Missing Lodger is accepted. After completing this quest, he lives with Ma'crish and will be in the Armu farm from 04:00 to 12:00. If the Smelly Perfume A route is chosen during Looking for Freedom, he will move out and stay in the Armu farm 24 hours a day. If Nic comes to Colony 6, Nopo'rikh asks the party to help him in Nic's Training. Nopo'rikh's and Nic's destinies are decided after defeating the Canyon Valencia and Tempest Vangs. In the English language version of the game, unlike most Nopon, Nopo'rikh noticeably speaks with fewer grammar tics associated with Riki and most other Nopon, explain
Night Tulips (Japanese: , Naito Chūrippu) are collectables in . They can be found in Tephra Cave. According to their description, they are tulips that reflect a beautiful black light.
Nine Caps (Japanese: , Nain Kyappu) are light head armour in . They can be found in Colony 9 and be bought or dropped from various enemies.
Nine Cuffs are light arms armour in . They can be dropped by Little Vangs.
Nine Shoes are light feet armour in . They can be bought at the Ether Light at Colony 9.
Nine Bottoms are light legs armour in . They can be dropped by Little Skeeters.
Nine Tops are light torso armour in . They can be bought from the Ether Light Shop in Colony 9.
Night Goggles (Japanese: , Naito Gōguru) are medium head armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies around Colony 9 and in Tephra Cave. They are designed for Homs soldiers on night patrols.

Nopol Gear (Japanese: , Noporu Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is made by Nopon, who imitate the Homs fashion of headgear. It is part of the Nopol series of armour, along with the Nopol Armour, Nopol Gauntlets, Nopol Leggings and Nopol Boots.
Noise Canceller (Japanese: , Noizu Kyanserā) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Nopol Gauntlets are medium arms armour in . They are made by Nopon imitating Homs fashion.

Nopol Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. Nopon made it, imitating Homs fashion. It is part of the Nopol series of armour along with the Nopol Gear, Nopol Gauntlets, Nopol Leggings and Nopol Boots.
Nopol Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing various quests. They are made by the Nopon imitating Homs fashion.
Nopol Leggings are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by the Nopon, imitating Homs fashion.

Nemesis Drones are Mechonis Drones in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by fusing tissue from Homs with parts from Mechonis. They are part of Fiora's original armour, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Napping Volfen (Japanese: , Gosui no Urufen) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Volff family, and can be found at level 17 in the Eastern part of Gaur Plain. It is typically accompanied by two level 15 Leg Volffs, and attacks on sight. It only appears during rainy days.

The Nicked Knife is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is located in the same cave as the Shining Pond in Satorl Marsh. The knife is necessary for Mementos of a Lost Son. It belonged to Cheryl's son.

Nature's Stove is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be found at the top of the higher level of the Eks Watering Hole in Makna Forest, in the small bay in the north-west of the area. The party is asked to collect it by Talonyth, for Cook-Off Final Blow?!.

Nightglow Staves (Japanese: , Yakō no Tsue) are weapons in . They fall under the category of Melia's staves. They can be dropped by Hover Astas and Nero Andos, and are rewards from the quest Trouble at the Lighthouse. They can also be acquired by trading with En Argentis who can be found in Alcamoth.
The Natura Defender (Japanese: , Kachōfūgetsu no Gotō, Guard Sword of Nature's Beauty) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a sword wielded by Dunban. It can be obtained from one shop only.
Night Sickles (Japanese: , Yamiyo no Kama) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban.

The Nopon Arch (Japanese: , Nopon'āchi) is a landmark in . It is located in Makna Forest, on the path between the Contaminated Area and the Eks Watering Hole. Jungle Quadwings can be found sitting on and around it, and the Elder Gragus lurks up a small path to the right of it.

New Parts S are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from various small Mechon in Agniratha, but cannot be traded for. Their description claims that their technology is too advanced for most people. Four of them are needed for Agniratha Beautification 1.

Mystical Klesida (Japanese: , Hōsen no Kurēshita) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Selua family, and can be found at level 72 in the Third Lung in Bionis' Interior, near the Vivid Anstan. It is an Ether monster and has high resistance to physical attacks.

New Parts L are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by M87/GRANDs, Exterminator/EMBERs, and M97/CYCLEs in Agniratha, found in particular north of Helas Pillar on the first floor. No one has them available for trade. Their description claims that their technology is too advanced for most people. Three of them are required for the quest Agniratha Beautification 2.

Natura Glyphs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Level 90-99 Unique Monsters. With a base sell price of 33,750 G, they are the second most valuable materials in the game, after Veritas Glyphs. According to their description, the truth of nature is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.
New Parts M are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from various Mechon in Agniratha. New Parts M are not otherwise available.
Niranira's Letter is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Niranira when Lonely Niranira is accepted and is to be delivered to Lukas.

Noble Brogs are enemies in . They are members of the Brog family, and can be found at level 12 at the Spring of Grief in Tephra Cave. Noble Brogs drop Brog Smelling Salts which are need to complete Material Quest 2. In , they can be found at the Purifying Falls on Bionis' Shoulder, and two must be defeated to complete Supplant the Noble Brogs and Laennar's Worries, both of which are given by Laennar.

Niece Ponios (Japanese: , Nīsu Ponio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Ponio family, and can be found at level 12 in the eastern part of Gaur Plain on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Ponio Neck Meat needed for A Thoughtful Idea.

The Nasty Weed is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the two choices that can be given to Matryona to complete Matryona's Answer. It can be found east of the Crown Tree in Satorl Marsh. Giving Matryona the Nasty Weed will produce the Repulsive Portrait.
New Game + is unlocked after beating the final boss in . It is absent in .

Night Cardamon (Japanese: , Yamiyo no Karudamon) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Wisp family and can be found at night near Kasharpa Falls. It can drop the Glowing Wisp Fluid needed for Emergency Treatment.

The Mythical Empress (Japanese: , Densetsu no Enpuresu) is a one-of-a-kind quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Queen family, and can be found in the Windy Cave on Bionis' Leg only during the quest Legend of Mythical Empress, and it must be defeated as part of the quest. This cave can only be reached by jumping down into the small hole directly south of Zax Guidepost, as instructed by Gerugu during the previous quest It Definitely Exist! and where the Daughter Empress were fought. The Mythical Empress is not a Unique Monster so does not give affinity coins.

This quest will expire when Junks leaves the Mechonis after the events at the Mechonis Core. New Weapon for Fiora (Japanese: , Fiorun no Shinbuki) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. This quest is available when the Central Factory is accessible during the second visit from the Ventilation Conduit by Junks while it is docked there, after the events at the Meyneth Shrine. It can be received from the westernmost Machina staff on the Junks. Upon talking to the Junks staff, the Weapon Material will be received. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment.

Nic's Training (Japanese: , Nūku: Han'ninmae Keikaku) is a quest in . It can be received from Nopo'rikh in Colony 6. Depending on the chosen route while completing the quest Looking for Freedom, Nopo'rikh can be found either near the Reconstruction HQ between 03:00 and 15:00 (B route, lodger), or anytime at the Armu Farm (A route, free). If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment. After the quest the party is given a choice of which type of enemy Nic will face. The choice does not matter, but whichever enemy they choose, Nopo'rikh will choose the opposite one for Nic's test. Nic's Final Test will be available after completing this quest.

Nic's Final Test (Japanese: , Nūku: Ichininmae Keikaku) is a quest in . It can be received from Nopo'rikh in Colony 6. Depending on the chosen route while completing the quest Looking for Freedom, Nopo'rikh can be found either near the Reconstruction HQ between 03:00 and 15:00 (B route, lodger), or anytime at the Armu Farm (A route, free). If Melia is in the active party, she will comment. At the end of the quest, the party is given a choice on which enemy Nic should face for his final test. This time, unlike in Nic's Training, Nopo'rikh will follow their choice. Either way, there is no difference in the outcome.
No Boys Allowed (Japanese: , Danshi wa Tachiirikinshi) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Sparkling Pool in Makna Forest, between Melia and Sharla at green affinity.

Kentaro Nagi or Secretary Nagi (Japanese: , Nagi Kentarō; English dub: ) is a recruitable playable character in . He was the former captain of the White Whale and serves as the Secretary of Defense in the autonomous government of New Los Angeles. He works himself tirelessly dealing with government affairs.

The Network was the multi-player mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. All the players of the Network were BLADE members. The players' Avatars appeared across Mira or the BLADE's Home. This online game mode consisted of a Squad of four-player online game mode for the special Squad Missions, as well as a Squad of up to 32 players online game mode for the BLADE Report consisting of online communication (in-game chat), item trading and information sharing functions, and for the Squad Tasks. With the shutdown of Wii U online services, the Network ceased to function, along with all of its online mechanics.

no3=NO.EX01 is a track in composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano with vocals provided by Mika Kobayashi. It is track three of disc one in the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, and the third part of the suite titled 0rCH-SUITE "X". This track is heard in certain story and mission boss battles, such as: * Almandal in Chapter 7 * Ryyz and Dagahn in Chapter 8 * Vasara and Deva Caladar in Chapter 9 * Zu Pharg (Phase 2) in Chapter 10 * Twin Qmoeva in Rites of Ruin * Ga Buidhe in A Challenger Approaches (only during repeat attempts) * The Tectonic Puges (only during repeat attempts) and MO037: Moore during The Duel (Part IV) * Gi Zang in The Lurker * The first battle with the Nameless Caladars in L

NEMOUSUOUS is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano with vocals provided by Yumiko Inoue. It is track 15 of disc one from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. The first half of the track is heard when Elma reveals her true form in the Lifehold Core. The second half is heard in multiple cutscenes in Affinity and Story Missions, often during deep conversations between the playable characters.

Nocto Blattas (Japanese: , Nokuto Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 2-7 at the Shadow Rise in Primordia at night. They can also be found at level 6-8 in a tunnel north of North Janpath Plain at any hour of the day.
Nagi's Time (Japanese: ) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received at the BLADE Barracks in New Los Angeles.

Nathan (Japanese: , Neisan) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at East Gate Plain in Primordia. After Welcome Back, Conner, he will be found near the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

New Orders is a Basic Mission in . It is a request from Vandham, and the primary destination is the briefing room in the BLADE Barracks. Like all Basic Missions, it can be received from the Mission Control Board on the Administrative District's BLADE Concourse. This mission leads to Chapter 4, but is not a prerequisite for that mission, and will become available even if the prerequisites for Chapter 4 have not been met.

Niobium Oc-servs (Japanese: , Niobu Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 34 on the triangular flat-topped rock structure by South Hardheart Canyon in Sylvalum.

Nine Lives (Japanese: , Bureido no Shigoto, A Blade's Work) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received near the northern end of Barista Court and the primary destination is Primordia. After this mission is completed, the Abyssinian Cat becomes available as a pet in the BLADE Barracks. In addition, five Search Request Basic Missions become available at the Mission Control board on the BLADE Concourse, in which the party is asked to rescue a lost dog or cat which then becomes available as a pet in the barracks. These five missions offers a specific reward: * Search Request (Primordia) * Search Request (Noctilum) * Search Request (Oblivia) * Search Request (Sylvalum) * Search Request (Cauld
Nomad Lepyxes (Japanese: , Nomado Fontera) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lepyx family, and can be found at level 31-40 northeast of FN Site 413 in Sylvalum.
Native Ovis (Japanese: , Neitibu Owisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ovis family, and can be found at level 41-43 in the meadow west of FN Site 413 in Sylvalum.

Nomad Terebras (Japanese: , Nomado Rutoru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Terebra family. They can be found at level 22-23 in Noctilum, just north of the Canopied Nightwood or west of FN Site 225. They drop Terebra Oil Grease, three units of which are needed for Skell Repair: Arm.
Negator Tectinsulas (Japanese: , Nega Tapenta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Tectinsula family, and can be found at level 21-23 in Decapotamon in Noctilum.

Native Saltats (Japanese: , Neitibu Sarutāto) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 25-27 in Oblivia, on the north shore of Lake Basel.
Nether Duoguills (Japanese: , Dīpu Guira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Duoguill family and can be found at level 28-30 in the Castaway Cavern in Primordia.
No Ma-non Need Apply (Japanese: , Kyozetsu, Rejection) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Wersal in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

The NLA Primary Defense Line is a story exclusive area in . It is located in Primordia near New Los Angeles' East Gate, but the party travels here automatically from the BLADE Barracks. It is the site of the first battles during Chapter 8 and exists only during these events.
The NLA Last Defense Line (Japanese: , NLA Saishū Bōei Rain) is a story exclusive area in . It is located in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. It exists only during Chapter 8.
Needle Rock Sandsea (Japanese: , Nīdoru Rokku no Sakai) is an area in . It is located in Sylvalum, right at the entrance from the Seabird's Beak.
Needle Rock BC (Japanese: , Nīdoru Rokku BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp located in Needle Rock Sandsea in Sylvalum.

The Needle Bridge BC (Japanese: , Nīdoru Burijji BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp located in Oblivia, east of Mesa Fortress. Between the fortress and this basecamp is an unnamed stretch of land spanning the Yawning Giant - presumably the Needle Bridge.

Nocturnal Vespers (Japanese: , Naito Usuperu, Night Vesper) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vesper family, and can be found at level 1-10 at East Gate Plain or at West Gate Plain in Primordia during the night. Four must be defeated during Arms Testers Wanted.

Native Scirpos (Japanese: , Neitibu Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 41-43 near Talon Rock Third Terrane and level 48-50 at Fallshorn Isle in Primordia. Five must be defeated for Squashing Scirpos (Native).

Nectar Scirpos (Japanese: , Nekutaru Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 25-26 east of FN Site 415 in Sylvalum. Five of them must be defeated during Sylvalum Trailblazing 2.
The Noctilum Collectopedia is a portion of the Collectopedia in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
The NLA Waters (Japanese: , NLA Kinkai) are a region in . These are the waters which surround the south of Primordia and New Los Angeles.

Nirvana Jonquils (Japanese: , Satorisuisen) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular around South Janpath Plain. One is needed for Definian Love.
Nickel Fal-swos (Japanese: , Nikkeru Gi-suo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Fal-swos machines, and can be found at level 31-32 at the Ruins on the Sandbank in Oblivia.
Nelly is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

New in New LA (Japanese: , Futari no Jijō, The Duo's Situation) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be accepted near the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District. Completing it allows Celica to be recruited as a party member.

The Narcissus Tree (Japanese: , Dokuson Taiju) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a small, bent tree located in Noctilum, southwest of Upper Hushflood. There are no enemies here other than three docile Tyrants. The name "Narcissus" comes from the Greek legend of Echo and Narcissus, which revolves around a young man who is eventually transformed into a flower that remains bent over a river as this tree is.
The NW Ciel Sandsea BC (Japanese: , Shieru-ko Hokusei BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp run by the Reclaimers, located on the West Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum.

Naza Tenpanzi (Japanese: , Nazu Tenikamonkī) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Tree Clan Prone, and can be found at Deliverance Park in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. She is in charge of replanting the Great Tree that her clan believes hold the spirits of their ancestors.

Nahum, the Red Hare (Japanese: , Sekito no Nahamu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a level 66 Milsaadi and can be found atop a flat-topped rock formation near Primordia's Bedrock Hold after completing Chapter 12. It is difficult to defeat her as she usually summons her Skell, the level 96 Nardacyon, the Shadowless, after her HP drops below 25%. During battles with Nahum, the Red Hare, the boss theme "CR17S19S8" plays instead of the standard Tyrant theme "Uncontrollable". She does not have an entry in the Enemy Index, nor does she drop any items if defeated.

Noka Mirrorstones (Japanese: , Noka Kagamiishi) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, usually in the northernmost regions (FN Site 207 for instance), as well as in the Vitriol Cesspool near FN Site 209. One is needed for The Pip-Squeak.

Noctilucent Dragonflies (Japanese: , Yakō Tonbo) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum near the Canopied Nightwood, Decapotamon, and around Everwhelm Falls. Six are required for A Tip of the Cap.

Myuena Cactuses (Japanese: , Myuena Saboten) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular on Big Arch. Five of them are needed for BLADE Mission No. 20's Squad Task.

Nopoliths (Japanese: , Noporisu) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia around the Dorian Caravan at late night. Gathering one is required during Professor B's Return.

Nightmare Pineapples (Japanese: , Kyomupain) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular around the south and southwest side of the region near Drongo Caravan and Fn Site 502 . Four are needed for New Product!.
Nan (English dub: ) is an NPC in . He can be found at the Nopon Bazaar in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Ngogo (Japanese: , N'gogo) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Nopon Bazaar in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

Native Forfexes (Japanese: , Neitibu Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 41-45 at South Coast and the beach under Ejiri Promontory in Oblivia. Seven of them must be defeated during Fending Off Forfexes (Native).
Neodymium Petramands (Japanese: , Neojimu Aranea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family and can be found at level 39-40 in Stonelattice Cavern in Primordia.
Natt, the Inestimable (Japanese: , Ōdō no Natto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can rarely be found at level 41-45 at FN Site 507 in Cauldros.

Nipopon Incarnate (Japanese: , Nipopon no Keshin) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Lophid family and Nipopon's incarnation. It can be found at level 56 at Old Ceremonial Hollow in Cauldros and must be defeated during the Normal Mission The Divine Nipopon.

Napopon Incarnate (Japanese: , Napopon no Keshin) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Ceto family and Napopon's incarnation. It can be found at level 56 at Azure Lagoon in Oblivia and must be defeated during the Normal Mission The Divine Napopon.

No-dhor, the Shadowcaster (Japanese: , Tōei no No-doa) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Fal-swo machine. It can be found at level 30 northwest of Lake Basel in Oblivia. No-dhor reflects gravity damage.

Nether Viragos (Japanese: , Dīpu Toruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Virago family, and can be found at level 52-59 at Abyss Reservoir in Sylvalum. They emerge from the ground. Behemoth, the Netherdweller may occasionally spawn instead of Nether Viragos.

Native Mortifoles (Japanese: , Neitibu Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mortifole family, and can be found at level 41-50 during the day, on the edge of the falls near FN Site 216 in Noctilum.

Nemard Wolfen (Japanese: , Nemado Urufen) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the day. He is Duna Valdileo's and Liana Valdileo's brother and Auld Belgazus's grandson.
Nana is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the day. During Castle in the Sky, she will be active at night instead.
Nococche (Japanese: , Nokotche) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Ma-non and can be found in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Neraph is a Ma-non in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is Giogion's sister, and can be found in the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship, one floor below the entrance behind a couple of crates.
Nan'celeg (Japanese: , Nan'osaragu) is an Orphean NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Nen'celeg is an Orphean NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She appears during House Call in Noctilum. She can then be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles after completing No-show Nen'celeg. She is the offspring and love interest of Nan'celeg, and the first Orphean born through non-linear division.

Nalu (Japanese: , Naru) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found northwest of Drongo Caravan in Cauldros during the day, at the base of the cliff at the eastern edge of the segment above FN Site 502.

No-show Nen'celeg (Japanese: , Akai Bunretsutai wo Sagase, Seek the Red Splinters) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Nan'celeg in the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship.

Non'barac is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is an Orphean who can be found at the Delusians South Summit in Sylvalum during the Orphean Pluck, then at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles in the daytime after this mission is completed.

The Naguth Caladar (Japanese: , Nagute Kakara) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the Caladar Skell piloted by Da Naguth fought at level 41 in Stickstone Rise in Primordia during The Queen Is Dead.

Nastasha (English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Barista Court in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles at daytime. She is a member of the Reclaimers division.
Ni Zinga (Japanese: , Ni Jinga) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian, and can be found at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia during the day.
Nauzo Snagi is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Nimu Turton (Japanese: , Nimuu Tāton) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Nio (Japanese: , Nio) is a Nopon NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the day after Castle in the Sky is completed.
Noborata is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Ma-non and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Neilnail Albus (Japanese: , Nīrunēru Arubu) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in . It is a Skell of unknown origin. It appears with Neilnail Furvus in Sylvalum at level 14-15 in the Squad Mission The Unknown Threat, and at level 50 in the Time Attack Mission Twin Dolls of Mystery. It drops the Crude Neilnail Masks needed to craft most level 60 Skell frames. Neilnail Albus is not registered in the Enemy Index.

Neilnail Furvus (Japanese: , Nīrunēru Nigeru) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in . It is a Skell of unknown origin. It appears with Neilnail Albus in Sylvalum at level 14-15 in the Squad Mission The Unknown Threat, and at level 50 in the Time Attack Mission Twin Dolls of Mystery. Neilnail Furvus is not registered in the Enemy Index. Shortly after engaging battle, Neilnail Furvus grants itself a multitude of buffs, including Calm, Ranged and Melee Attack Up, and Barrier.
Noble Silks are two Important Items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be acquired from the two Noble Arachnids in Sylvalum's South Cinderdunes during Predator and Prey but only one is requested.
New Frontier (Japanese: , Atarashiki Furontia) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty on the south side of the Residential District's Water Purification Plant.
Nalu's Present is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from Lularita during B Route ("Consider") of Supplies Surprise, and is to be delivered to Nalu.
New Product! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Nopon Commerce Guild and the primary destination is Cauldros.
Nixing Lepyxes is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Dopang Caravan and the primary destination is Sylvalum.
No Friends Like Nopon is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Interceptors and the primary destination is Noctilum.

Nameless Caladars (Japanese: , Mumei Kakara) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Caladar Skells, and they are fought in Cauldros in three battle waves during Lionhearted. Three of them are fought at level 52-53 at the Ganglion Weapons Hangar. Five of them are then fought at level 50 near the Wildcat Fortress. A final one is fought at level 55 at Kw'arah Cloister.
Ni Zain (English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian, and can be found at Barista Court in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

The Network Console is a usable terminal in . It is located in a circular room in the northern part of BLADE Barracks. The console provides access to a variety of Network functions, many of which required an Internet connection. With the shutdown of Wii U online services, only the Support Missions and Time Attack Missions remain accessible in the Wii U version.

Noble Yggralith Scales are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are given out as rewards for taking RP from Yggralith Zero after the Nemesis is defeated or flees. They are used to craft the True and Infinite BLADE Wear series.

Nardacyon is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Nardacyon, the Shadowless, a black and gold Almandal. It can be obtained from silver drops from it in Primordia, appearing after a battle engagement with its pilot, Nahum, the Red Hare.

Noble Sacrifice is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Kun'luarb and his noble sacrifice for the Orphean survival during Circle of Life. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.

No Words is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Sun'barac, a candidate looking to stand as a spokerperson for the xenoforms of New LA during The Party Line. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.

Neighborhood Watch is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.9, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty-two Saltats. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

None Save the Queen is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.11, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Milsaadi. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Napopon is a NPC in . She can be found at the Azure Lagoon in Oblivia during The Divine Nopopon, and is fought as Napopon Incarnate. She is one of four divine Nopon spirits alongside Nipopon, Nopopon and Nupopon.

Nipopon is a NPC in . He can be found at the Old Ceremonial Hollow in Cauldros during The Divine Nopopon, and is fought as Nipopon Incarnate. He is one of four divine Nopon spirits alongside Napopon, Nopopon and Nupopon.
Ni Gombe is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian. Initially he can be found on the Deck of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. After The Lurker he moves to the Port Side of the ship.

Noctilum Nights is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and is intended to make it easier to level up characters by earning EXP, Class EXP, and Battle Points. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Night-Cage is an intergalactic shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is dropped by fuse blower wielding Seidrs. It launches two shots that hits the enemy many times. This weapon fills both slots.
Night Vision is a ground weapon special augment in and . It increases melee and ranged accuracy at night by 10% to 50%. The Skell equivalent is Night.MR-ACC.
Nio's IOU is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained after paying 20,000 credits to Nio during Hair Apparent.
Night.MR-ACC is a Skell weapon special augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases melee and ranged accuracy at night by 1% to 20%. It is the Skell equivalent of Night Vision.
Nagi's Bodywear is Casual Wear full-body armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Nagi's initial gear when he is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
The Needlegun is an arm weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from creed revolver type Galdrs, Petramands or Vigents.
N-Cannons are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims or Oc-servs.

Nia (Japanese: , Nia, Niyah) is one of the main playable characters in . She is a Gormotti Driver and is accompanied by her Blade, Dromarch, who calls her "Lady" (, Ojōsama) like a butler. She comes from Gormott Province. Originally a member of Torna, she defects to Rex's side after Pyra's awakening. __TOC__

New Cylinders are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Azul Andos and Hover Astas in the High Entia Tomb. New Cylinders are also available through trading with Donnis in Alcamoth. According to their description, they have not been used yet, but they could have a lot of applications. Five New Cylinders are needed for the quest Restoring the Capital 2.

Niall Ardanach (Japanese: , Neferu Eru Superubia) is the Emperor of the Ardainian Empire in . He is the younger cousin of Special Inquisitor Mòrag, though the two were raised together by his father and consider each other siblings. He is also a Driver, and Aegaeon is his Blade. He can be found in the Throne Room of the Hardhaigh Palace until Chapter 6. He is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Naleeze is an NPC in . Naleeze is an Urayan who can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. Naleeze runs a shop called Cleo's Cosmetics specialized in Cosmetics.
Nalinali is an NPC in . Nalinali is a Nopon who can be found at the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild. Nalinali runs a shop called Strummer Instruments specialized in Board Games.

Noodler's Delight (Japanese: , Men'ya Chanopon) is a shop in . It is run by Zuzu and can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. It sells only one product, Argentum Noodle Soup, but due to its extreme popularity, the party can only buy some between the hours of 0:00 and 5:00. It is also one of the few stores that does not sell a Store Deed.

Niranira (Japanese: , Nirunī) is a Nopon in . He can be found next to a tree in the southwestern portion of the Residential District of Colony 9. After Lonely Niranira, he can be found playing with Lukas and Moritz.

The Nocclia Timber Site (Japanese: , Nokirua Bassaijō) is a landmark in . It is located in the right area of the upper level of the Gormott Province, deep in the Nocclia Woods. There are no enemies here.

The Nocclia Woods (Japanese: , Nokirua Shinrin-ku) are a location in . They are located in the right area of the upper level of the Gormott Province and are accessible from the Plains of Evening Calm via the tree trunk frequented by Territorial Rotbart. The Nocclia Timber Site and Traveler's Resting Tree are here, and the Honeypot Grotto is directly north. During the Aegis War, as shown in , the Nocclia Woods were instead known as Hoary Weald.
Nharil Central Plaza (Japanese: , Nahāru Chūō Hiroba) is a Landmark in . It is located in Alba Cavanich of the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Narcipear Jellies are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Honeycomb Sweets in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Nopoleles are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Strummer Instruments in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.
The Neuromin Deeds are deeds key items in . They can be purchased from Neuromin Textiles run by Yul in the Gormott Province's Torigoth.
Neuromin Textiles is a shop in . It is run by Yul and can be found in the Gormott Province's Torigoth, at the lower eastern level of the Grodd Residential Zone. It is specialized in Textiles.
Noagh is an NPC in . Noagh is an Ardainian who can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Noagh runs a shop called Elgeschel Hobby Store specialized in Board Games.

Neon Grape Flans are Dessert Pouch items in . They are one of Gorg's favorite Pouch items, and can be made at his Just Desserts shop in Fonsa Myma using his "Patissier" field skill. The shop is unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Follow Your Passion.

Nitpicking Beru (Japanese: , Togayari no Borufu) is a Unique Monster in . He is a Driver and can be found at level 27 in the left cell of Solitary Block #2 aboard the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province. He must be defeated to unlock T-elos's level 2 MAGDALENE 16.

Nests (Japanese: , Nesuto) are a family of enemies in the . Nests are unusual in that they hold other enemies, which emerge after a certain amount of time. Nests typically hold Fliers or other insectoid enemies. To this extent, they resemble Pods, which tend to release Antols and Arachnos.

Nolha is an NPC in . She can be found at Ayvill Shopping District in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. She sits just outside of Salter Sweets. If Floren is in the party and has Lv 1 Beguiling Charms, she will give 10 Steamed Milk Brioches.
Nimble Nopon Get Girls is a Key Item in . It can be found in a Treasure Trove at the Greatmaw Rapids in the Kingdom of Uraya. It unlocks new parts in Poppiswap.

Neon Cookies are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be made at Gorg's Just Desserts shop in Fonsa Myma using his "Patissier" field skill. The shop is unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Follow Your Passion.

Nix is an NPC in . Nix is a Phonex who can be found in Torigoth, Gormott. Nix can only be spoken to if Nim is in the party with Lv 2 "Phonex Linguistics". Nix grazes around the lower end of Obra Street.

Nairoo Bunnits (Japanese: , Nairuzu Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 18-24 at various locations in the Kingdom of Uraya, including Cleansing Spring, Lake Varna, Drillbore Bridge, Stone Gate Ruins. Those found in the Stomach tend to be of higher level than those in the Head.

The Nongl Tirkin (Japanese: , Songeru Tākin) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 40 at the Tirkin Turf in the Gormott Province during Our Daily Bread.

Nefto Lizards (Japanese: , Nefuto Rizado) are enemies in . They are members of the Lizard family, and can be found at level 17-22 throughout the Kingdom of Uraya, including the Acid Gullet, Lake Varna and Drillbore Bridge.

Nomad Rhinons (Japanese: , Nomaddo Raino) are enemies in . They are members of the Rhinon family, and can be found at level 20-25 throughout the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at Lake Varna, Farlaine Wells, Drillbore Bridge and the Old Quarry. Two must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 2 Fuga Daemonum Blade Special.

Neleid Jagrons (Japanese: , Nereido Jagāru) are enemies in . They are members of the Jagron family, and can be found at level 86-90 at the Titan Weapon Dig Site or the Jagron's Citadel on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Night Huust Quadwings (Japanese: , Naitohaido Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 46-48 at Malignant Gorge on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Noign Pods (Japanese: , Noigen Poddo) are enemies in . They are Pods that can be found at level 41-43 at the Ruined Chapel of Danafas on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Nant Buloofos (Japanese: , Niggusu Urusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Buloofo family, and can be found at level 40 - 42 at the Little Banerro Ruins on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. Three of them must be defeated to unlock T-elos's level 3 "Phase Transition Tech".
Nebri Ropls (Japanese: , Neburi Ryibura) are enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 82-87 in Heimos's Crevasse on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.
Noigan Garluses (Japanese: , Noigan Garuusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 49 - 55 at the Sacred Grove on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Nacre Chokers (Japanese: , Nanairokai no Chōkā) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's Luck stat by up to 22%. The Goddess Choker, Comet Choker, and Sunlight Choker accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Bunnit Choker and Gold Gear Choker accessories. Outside of combat, they slightly improve the odds of bonding with Rare Blades during Blade Resonance.
Nail Stones are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Cliffs of Morytha.
Necromanta Rays are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, in particular from the three Collection Points of Subterranean Lake Galantia.

Neon Grapes are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha, specifically at the Collection Point located at the Runo Cave-in Skip Travel Point. In the , Neon Grapes can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo. One is needed during Souvenirs from Morytha.

Nitrotoluites are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular from the Collection Point located south from the Hot Pipe District, 1F, behind some vertical pipes, by going up the stairs nearby and heading into the building. Five of them are needed to unlock Corvin's level 3 "Forestry" Field Skill.
Noise Bites are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Nano-Metal Gauntlets (Japanese: , Nanometaru Gantoretto) are accessories in . They increase the amount of Special Gauge recharged after cancelling by up to 44%. They are the upgraded version of the Gauntlet and Bio Gauntlet accessories. The DLC exclusive Carbon Gauntlet accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.
Needles of Terror are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Indoline Praetorium.
Nameko Gems are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree. In the , Nameko Gems can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Nakhlite Chips are Core Chips in . They can be bought from the Bamboo Sword Smithy in the Cliffs of Morytha, and dropped by various enemies primarily in the Land of Morytha. Nakhlite Chips share their appearance with Aubrite Chips, Howardite Chips, and Angrite Chips. __TOC__
Natto Lizards (Japanese: , Natto Rizado) are enemies in . They are members of the Lizard family, and can be found at level 26-33 at the Thermal Exhaust Fork in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Neml Pippitos (Japanese: , Nemiru Pipitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 28 - 30 at the Valdorm's Mound in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Noog Skeeters (Japanese: , Nekuro Sukīto) are enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 24-26 at the Cargo Transportation Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Ten must be defeated during the quest Road to the Capital. One must be defeated at level 31 in the Great Heat Extraction Duct to obtain the Sensitive Documents during the quest Hard to Stomach.

Noog Vangs (Japanese: , Negura Vanpu) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 28-29 at the Thermal Exhaust Fork in the Empire of Mor Ardain during Ecological Survey. They are the only source of Whitescale Antennas.
Night Avys Quadwings (Japanese: , Naitoabisu Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 34 on Daram Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Nelva Pippitos (Japanese: , Neruva Pipitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 47-51 at the Runo Cave-in in the Cliffs of Morytha.

No-Penny Nopon is a quest in . It can be received from Shatoto at Garagorm's Arch in the Gormott Province during the third objective of the quest The Militia's Request. Shatoto can be found about halfway down the tower in a small alcove, by dropping down from the top.
Natheus is an NPC in . Natheus is a Gormotti who can be found at the Saets Lumber Co. in the Gormott Province. Natheus gives the quest Repair Torigoth's Crane.

Noelle is an NPC in . She can be found in Fonsa Myma's Commercial District in the Kingdom of Uraya. She is an Ardainian who, despite the escalating tensions, lives in Fonsa Myma with her husband, who is Urayan. She is the daughter of Mabon and sister of Antis, and she was raised in Gormott by Mabon and his Blade, Vess. She must be spoken to during Vess' Blade Quest, Tranquility, and also takes part in her Heart-to-Heart, "Reunion". Noelle offers no quests or Merc Missions.
Neel is an NPC in . Neel is a Gormotti who can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Nomul Lysaats (Japanese: , Namuru Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 31-36 at the Ansel Hatchery in the Leftherian Archipelago after Salvaging.
Nilhez Squoods (Japanese: , Niruheizu Suīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Squood family, and can be found at level 52-56 at Jubilee Gate on the Cliffs of Morytha after Salvaging.
Nekrino Marrins (Japanese: , Nekurisasu Mārin) are enemies in . They are members of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 50-54 at Jubilee Gate at the Cliffs of Morytha after Salvaging.

The Nanda Arachno (Japanese: , Nananda Supaido) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 50 near the Koorell Pool in the Gormott Province during the quest Go for it, Electra!.
Nomon is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at Kloom Farm in the Gormott Province. He gives the quest Grow, Little Vegetables! and the Merc Mission Manufacture Help.
Navarre is an NPC in . He can be found at Nharil Central Plaza in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He makes an appearance in the quest Newt Recruits.

Nel Arachnos (Japanese: , Neiru Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 26-30 in the Old Industrial District on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. They can be summoned at level 26-29 by Spitt Pod's art "Emergence".
Neb (Japanese: , Nāba) is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya.
